United States Surtax Order (Steel and Aluminum 2025)

SOR/2025-95

Registered 12 March 2025. Effective 13 March 2025.

A surtax of 50 percent of the value for duty is imposed on goods originating in the United States that fall within the classifications listed in Schedule 3.

Schedule 2 was replaced by Schedule 3 on 8 September 2026.
